verdict.rationale: Stripe's Disputes API explicitly supports retrieving disputes, uploading evidence, and submitting responses programmatically, and webhooks notify of dispute events, which together enable an agent to handle disputes end-to-end via API. However, there's no dedicated evidence that an AI agent (e.g., via MCP) specifically automates dispute assembly/submission — the MCP server is documented as a general API interface without dispute-specific agent workflows demonstrated.
